title: Agent Role State
description: Structured checkpoint for agent role state. Written after each deliverable, read at session start for fast resume. Replaces freeform STATE.md.

scope.description: Org or org/project scope for the role. Examples: 'lanytehq', '3leaps/ipcprims'. Default: 'default'. Hash chain is per (role, scope).

authored_by.description: Attribution for the entity writing this checkpoint. Structured for parseability but NOT a verified identity — trust level depends on whether the session is attested (see session_ref). Does not affect the hash chain.

actor_type.description: Category of actor. 'supervised_agent' = model operating under human supervision (Claude Code, Codex). 'human' = person acting directly. 'autonomous_agent' = persistent process with its own identity (future).

supervisor.description: Handle of the human supervisor for supervised_agent sessions. This is the trust anchor — the human who attested or could attest the session.

model.description: Self-reported model name (e.g., 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gpt-5-codex'). Unreliable — models may misidentify. Treat as best-effort metadata.

handle.description: User handle for human actors (e.g., '3leapsdave'). For autonomous agents, their registered identity ref (future).

session_ref.description: Session attestation token (JWT) or its hash. When present, indicates the session was attested by a human supervisor via lanyte-attest. When absent, the checkpoint is unattested — attribution is self-reported only. See CRT-012 for the attestation mechanism.

session_type.description: How the writing session ended. Guides the next session's warm-up path.

status_summary.description: One-paragraph summary of current state. The single thing a resuming agent reads first.

id.description: Task ID from the workstream board (e.g., CRT-004, AGI-011)

next_action.description: The specific next thing to do when resuming this task

ref.description: Reference to ADR, brief, or chat thread (e.g., ADR-0010, AGI-011)

decisions.description: Decisions made since last checkpoint. Prevents re-derivation on resume.

blocked_by.description: What this action is waiting on (task ID, person, event)

pending_actions.description: Actions this role is tracking but hasn't completed yet

pushed.description: Whether changes have been pushed to remote

modified_files.description: Repos with uncommitted or unpushed changes at checkpoint time

blockers.description: Current blockers preventing progress. Empty array = unblocked.

context_refs.description: File paths or URLs a resuming agent should read to rebuild context. Keep this minimal — only files needed for the active task, not the full warm-up sequence.
